fields.label: Last Sequence
fields.description: Must rise forever, including across watcher restarts, so it is seeded from the clock and needs more than 4 bytes.

fields.label: POS Version
fields.description: The version of the POS application this till is running. Separate from the watcher version: the two ship together today, but a till that failed to update is exactly the case this field exists to make visible.

fields.label: Unsynced Orders
fields.description: Orders taken on this till that have not reached the server yet. A number that only grows is a till that is selling but not syncing, which looks perfectly healthy from every other angle.

fields.label: Last Sync
fields.description: The last time this till successfully pushed its queue. Blank means it has never managed one.

fields.label: Last Error
fields.description: What went wrong on the till most recently, in its own words. Cleared as soon as the till reports a healthy sweep, so a till wearing this is failing NOW rather than having failed once.

fields.label: Key Issued At
fields.description: The key is handed over exactly once. Blank means it has not been collected yet.

fields.label: Asked Again At
fields.description: The last time this till asked to join while the server already had a key on record for it. A till only asks when it has nothing stored, so this means the key it was given is gone - a reimaged PC, a wiped profile - and it cannot recover on its own. Somebody has to reissue.

fields.label: Asked Again By
fields.description: The computer that last asked for a key this till had already collected. When it is not the computer the key was issued to, a different machine is claiming this till - which a manager should look at before reissuing, because the reissued key goes to whichever machine asks next.

fields.label: Past Warm-up
fields.description: Reported by the watcher. While warming up its empty view is not evidence that anybody left.

fields.label: Blind
fields.description: The watcher cannot even see the router. The branch is unreachable, not empty.

fields.label: Local Address
fields.description: Where this till answers on the SHOP network, e.g. http://192.168.0.104:7331. Only reachable from inside the shop; it is what a pairing QR points at.
